elements.description:
System and developer instructions with highlighted variables, missing and unused variable warnings, an
app-supplied token count, a diff against a chosen version and Save as a new version.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: value
properties.description: The role and the text. Changed by the user unless tc-value-change is prevented

properties.name: roles
properties.description: Which instructions these can be; fewer than two hides the switch

properties.name: variables
properties.description: The variables the app fills in; the text is checked against them

properties.name: versions
properties.description: Saved versions, oldest first. Grows when Save isn't prevented

properties.name: compareTo
properties.description: The id of the version the text is compared with; unset compares with the latest

properties.name: tokenCount
properties.description: The text's length in tokens, as the app counts it; unset shows no count

properties.name: tokenLimit
properties.description: The most tokens the instructions should use; past it the count turns red

properties.name: counting
properties.description: The app is counting the tokens for the latest text

properties.name: placeholder
properties.default: "Say who the model is working for, what it should do and what it must not do. Use {{name}} for what the app fills in."

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the text

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Shows everything but nothing can be changed

properties.name: variableUses
properties.description: Every variable the text uses or the app defines, with its status

properties.name: comparedVersion
properties.description: The version the text is compared with

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The text differs from the latest version (or there is none yet and the text isn't empty)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The text or the role changed, or a version was restored ({ value: InstructionEditorValue }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-save
events.description: Save as a new version was pressed ({ version, versions }: InstructionSaveEvent); cancelable – prevented, `versions` stays as it was

methods.name: insertVariable
methods.description: Inserts {{name}} at the caret, or in place of the selection

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the text as a new version: fires tc-save and, unless it's prevented, adds the version

functions.name: instructionVariables
functions.description: The variables a text uses, by name, with how often

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group and the editor

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The role and the text to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the role and the text after every edit

props.name: defaultVersions
props.description: The versions to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onSave
props.description: Save as a new version was pressed: `version` is the one to add, `versions` the list with it
